title: ABIDE WITH ME - CHRISTIAN SONG

lines: ABIDE with me; fast falls the eventide;

Change and decay in all around I see;
O Thou, who changest not, abide with me!
3. Come not in terrors, as the King of Kings;
But kind and good, with healing in Thy wings;
Tears for all woes, a heart for every plea;
Come, Friend of sinners, thus abide with me.
4. I need Thy presence every passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Oh, abide with me!
5. I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness:
Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me.
6. Be Thou Thyself before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom, and point me to the skies;
Heaven's morning breaks, and earth's vain shadows flee;
In life, in death, O Lord, abide with me!

lines: यीशु मसीह ने पापी जग से, ऐसा प्यार दिखाया,
सबके पाप मिटा देने को, अपना खून बहाया।
आज बुलाता है वह हम सबको, आओ तौबा कर लो,
उसकी रहमत सबके लिए है, अपनी झोली भर लो,
उसके दर पे जो भी आया, कब उसने ठुकराया।
दुआ करो और भक्ति में रहो, वह तुमको रोज सिखाए,
प्यार करो तुम दुश्मन से भी, हमको यही सिखाए,
क्रूस पे चढ़कर कैसा उसने प्यार का रंग दिखाया।
बेबस और मजबूर ग़मों के मारों को है बुलाता,
भूले-भटके राही को प्यार की राह दिखाता,
हर पापी को गले लगाकर प्यार से अपना बनाया।
Yeshu Masiha Ne Papi Jag Se, Aisa Pyaar Dikhaya,
Sabke Paap Mita Dene Ko, Apna Khoon Bahaya.
Aaj Bulata Hai Woh Hum Sabko, Aao Tauba Kar Lo,
Uski Rehmat Sabke Liye Hai, Apni Jholi Bhar Lo,
Uske Dar Pe Jo Bhi Aaya, Kab Usne Thukraya.
Dua Karo Aur Bhakti Mein Raho, Woh Tumko Roz Sikhaye,
Pyaar Karo Tum Dushman Se Bhi, Humko Yehi Sikhaye,
Kroos Pe Chadhkar Kaisa Usne Pyaar Ka Rang Dikhaya.
Bebas Aur Majboor Ghamon Ke Maron Ko Hai Bulata,
Bhule-Bhatke Rahi Ko Pyaar Ki Raah Dikhata,
Har Papi Ko Gale Lagakar Pyaar Se Apna Banaya.
Jesus the Messiah showed such love to this sinful world,
To erase the sins of all, He shed His own blood.
Today He calls us all: come and repent,
His mercy is for everyone; come with open hands,
Whoever came to His door, He never turned away.
Pray and walk in devotion; He will teach you day by day,
Love even your enemies; this is what He taught us,
On the cross He revealed the color of divine love.
He calls the helpless and the burdened in sorrow,
He shows the path of love to the lost wanderer,
He embraces every sinner and makes them His own in love.
Yeshu Mashiha paapi lokathinodu ithra valiya sneham kaatti,
Ellavarude paapam neekkanaan avan thante raktam chorinju.
Innu avan nammale ellavareyum vilikkunnu: varu, manassu thiriyuka,
Avante karuna ellavarkkum vendiyanu; ningalude jholi nirakkuka,
Avante aduthekk vannavane avan orikkalum thalliyilla.
Prarthikkuka, bhakthiyil nilkkuka; avan ningale dinamprathi padhippikkum,
Shathruvineyum snehikkuka; nammale avan angane padhippichu,
Kroosil kayari avan daivika sneham enthaanu ennu kaanichu.
Marannu poya yaathrakkaranu sneha vazhi kaanichu kodukkunnu,

Hari charaiyon me mujhe, sneh se chalata wah hei
